dataset: Westwood One Sports national broadcasts OUTSIDE the NFL — NCAA Football and U.S. Soccer
priority: normal (national radio window; not a Giants/A's/49ers/Stanford/Cal game)
sourceName: Westwood One Sports — official sport schedule pages
verifiedBy: Read directly from the live official pages on 2026-11-05 (agent page fetch). Each event links to its own official event page.
notes: These are Westwood One national radio windows, not station-level carriage. Times on the source pages are Eastern; Pacific times here are converted at ET-3h (PST is in effect from 2026-11-01). Rows whose air time reads 'TBD' on the official page carry a null start and are blocked across the plausible 12:00-23:30 Pacific window, not a fabricated clock time.
irregularities: 2026-11-14 Texas Tech at Oklahoma State and 2026-11-21 LSU at Tennessee are listed with 'Air time TBD' on the official event pages; the start time is left blank and the rows are flagged.
Westwood One's San Francisco affiliates (KNBR-AM, KNBR-FM, KNBR-F2, KTCT-AM) are published by market, not per sport or per event; the network states that not every affiliate airs every broadcast.
